correctness.rationale: For n>=2 the Jones monoid rank-(n-2) diagrams are uniquely indexed by (i,j) adjacent cup/cap positions. Diagram multiplication retains rank n-2 exactly when intermediate |j-k|<=1; idempotents are d_ij with |i-j|<=1, 3n-5 elements, as the East--Gray lemma. For distinct idempotents equal commuting products cannot retain rank n-2 because top and bottom preserved cups/caps would force equality. If rank falls to n-4, disjointness of top and bottom pairs together with rank constraints imposes pairwise distance >=2 between all generator-support indices; conversely distant TL generators commute. Hence commuting subsets correspond bijectively to separated interval tiles of length 1 with weight z or length 2 with weight 2z. Splitting by first site gives P0=1,P1=1+z,P2=1+4z, Pm=P(m-1)+zP(m-2)+2zP(m-3), and numerator (1+zu+2zu^2). Counting compatible pairs gives K_n=1,4,9n²-66n+129 on the stated n ranges; tile spacing yields largest clique floor(n/2), multiplicity 1 for even n and (3n-1)/2 for odd n. Independently implemented literal planar pairing union-find multiplication, tested all idempotent pairs, commute criterion and full clique enumeration for 2<=n<=8, yielding P2=[1,4], P3=[1,7,1], P4=[1,10,7], P5=[1,13,22,1], etc. Verified recurrence and boundary cases; the symbolic interval bijection supplies all n.
residual_risks: Finite calculations support the structural proof; they are not a proof by sampling.

originality.rationale: East--Gray 2014 Lemma 9.8 supplies the rank n-2 idempotent stratum as an input, not a novelty claim. Its Section 9.3/9.4 count ranks and minimal generating sets/ideals, not pairwise commuting families or the full clique polynomial. Dolinka et al count individual idempotents, distinct from clique compatibility. The exact interval tiling model could be expressible in hard-core or matching polynomial language, but no cited source gives the Jones-specific commutation criterion as a theorem; best-of-knowledge original.
